examples.chinese: A：你今天早上有課嗎？ B：我今天早上沒有課。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ jīntiān zǎoshang yǒu kè ma? B: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang méi yǒu kè.
examples.english: A: Do you have class this morning? B: I don’t have class this morning.

examples.chinese: B:我今天早上沒有課？ A:你今天早上有課嗎？
examples.pinyin: B: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang méiyǒu kè? A: Nǐ jīntiān zǎoshang yǒu kè ma?
examples.english: B: I don't have class this morning? A: Do you have class this morning?

examples.chinese: 我早上沒有課，九點去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang méi yǒu kè, jiǔ diǎn qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: I don’t have class in the morning. I am going to the library at 9:00.

examples.chinese: 我每天坐捷運去上課，我覺得很方便。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zuò jiéyùn qù shàngkè, wǒ juéde hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: I take the MRT to class every day; I think it's very convenient.

examples.chinese: 他不在教室裡上課，那他在哪裡？
examples.pinyin: Tā bù zài jiàoshì lǐ shàngkè, nà tā zài nǎlǐ?
examples.english: He is not in the classroom having class, so where is he?

examples.chinese: 新學期快要開始了。我們每天八點四十分開始上課。
examples.pinyin: Xīn xuéqī kuài yào kāishǐ le. Wǒmen měi tiān bā diǎn sìshí fēn kāishǐ shàngkè.
examples.english: The new semester is about to start. We start class at 8:40 every day.

examples.chinese: 國安發燒了，不能來上課，我有點兒擔心他。
examples.pinyin: Guó'ān fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè, wǒ yǒudiǎnr dānxīn tā.
examples.english: Guo'an has a fever and cannot come to class; I am a little worried about him.

examples.chinese: 我感冒了，想給老師打電話，跟他說我不能去上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, xiǎng gěi lǎoshī dǎ diànhuà, gēn tā shuō wǒ bù néng qù shàngkè.
examples.english: I caught a cold; I want to call the teacher to tell him I can't go to class.

examples.chinese: 我去上課以前，一定會先在家吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù shàngkè yǐqián, yídìng huì xiān zài jiā chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: Before I go to class, I definitely will first eat breakfast at home.

examples.chinese: 他每天早上去上班，晚上去上課，真辛苦！
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang qù shàngbān, wǎnshang qù shàngkè, zhēn xīnkǔ!
examples.english: He goes to work every morning and goes to class in the evening; it's really tough!

examples.chinese: 因為最近太多人感冒的關係，來上課的同學變少了，我們班不過十個人，就有五個人請假 。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi zuìjìn tài duō rén gǎnmào de guānxi, lái shàngkè de tóngxué biàn shǎo le, wǒmen bān búguò shí ge rén, jiù yǒu wǔ ge rén qǐngjià.
examples.english: Because too many people have caught colds recently, fewer classmates are coming to class; in our class of only ten people, five have asked for leave.

examples.chinese: 黃教授不僅知識豐富、上課認真，還很關心學生，大家都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Huáng jiàoshòu bùjǐn zhīshì fēngfù, shàngkè rènzhēn, hái hěn guānxīn xuéshēng, dàjiā dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: Professor Huang not only has rich knowledge and teaches seriously, but also cares about students very much; everyone respects him greatly.

examples.chinese: 陳老師為了引起學生的學習興趣，每次上課前都會準備一些有趣的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Chén lǎoshī wèile yǐnqǐ xuéshēng de xuéxí xìngqù, měi cì shàngkè qián dōu huì zhǔnbèi yīxiē yǒuqù de yóuxì.
examples.english: In order to arouse the students' interest in learning, Teacher Chen prepares some interesting games before every class.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文程度，我除了認真上課、寫作業，還每天聽收音機的英文廣播。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù, wǒ chúle rènzhēn shàngkè, xiě zuòyè, hái měi tiān tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō.
examples.english: In order to raise my English level, besides attending class seriously and doing homework, I also listen to English radio broadcasts every day.

examples.chinese: 因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi shuǐzāi de guānxi, xǔduō xuéxiào méi bànfǎ zhèngcháng shàngkè, shènzhì lián biànlì shāngdiàn dōu guān le.
examples.english: Because of the flood, many schools cannot have classes normally; even convenience stores have closed.

examples.chinese: 林同學上課很專心，也很認真地把老師教的寫下來，這樣回家就能複習了。
examples.pinyin: Lín tóngxué shàngkè hěn zhuānxīn, yě hěn rènzhēn de bǎ lǎoshī jiāo de xiě xiàlái, zhèyàng huí jiā jiù néng fùxí le.
examples.english: Student Lin is very focused in class and also very seriously writes down what the teacher teaches, so that he can review when he goes home.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人使用網路上課，所以手機、電腦也就變成了重要的學習工具。
examples.pinyin: Yuèláiyuè duō rén shǐyòng wǎnglù shàngkè, suǒyǐ shǒujī, diànnǎo yě jiù biànchéng le zhòngyào de xuéxí gōngjù.
examples.english: More and more people use the Internet for classes, so mobile phones and computers have also become important learning tools.

examples.chinese: 上課時他把筆記寫在本子上，也把重點寫在不同顏色的便條(紙)上。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè shí tā bǎ bǐjì xiě zài běnzi shàng, yě bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài bùtóng yánsè de biàntiáo (zhǐ) shàng.
examples.english: During class he wrote the notes in his notebook, and also wrote the key points on sticky notes of different colors.

examples.chinese: 啊！上課了！我們先上課吧。
examples.pinyin: A! Shàngkè le! Wǒmen xiān shàngkè ba.
examples.english: Ah! The class has started! Let’s go to class now.

examples.chinese: 我平常坐紅線去學校上課，週末也坐捷運去運動、看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zuò hóng xiàn qù xuéxiào shàngkè, zhōumò yě zuò jiéyùn qù yùndòng, kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: I usually go to school by the red one. On weekends I take it to exercise or see a movie as well.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 老師，國安今天要請假。他發燒了，不能來上課。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, Guó'ān jīntiān yào qǐngjià. Tā fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè.
examples.english: Teacher, Guoan has to take a leave today. He has a fever and he can’t come to school.

examples.chinese: 他打電話跟我說，他不能來上課，請我幫他請假。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎ diànhuà gēn wǒ shuō, tā bù néng lái shàngkè, qǐng wǒ bāng tā qǐngjià.
examples.english: He gave me a call and told me that he couldn’t make it to class and asked me to ask for a leave for him.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

examples.chinese: 我們都希望他明天能回學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu xīwàng tā míngtiān néng huí xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: We all hope he can come back to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我明天要上書法課，現在要去買毛筆！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yào shàng shūfǎ kè, xiànzài yào qù mǎi máobǐ!
examples.english: I have calligraphy class tomorrow; I need to go buy a writing brush now!

examples.chinese: 現在他在上書法課，我們四點去吧。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tā zài shàng shūfǎ kè, wǒmen sì diǎn qù ba.
examples.english: He is in the calligraphy class now. Let’s do it at 4 p.m.

examples.chinese: 可是從四點到五點半我要上英文課，六點去，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Kěshì cóng sì diǎn dào wǔ diǎn bàn wǒ yào shàng Yīngwén kè, liù diǎn qù, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: But I have an English class from 4 to 5:30 p.m. How about 6 p.m.?

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

examples.chinese: 我的中文書很多，你要不要看？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Zhōngwén shū hěn duō, nǐ yào bú yào kàn?
examples.english: I have many Chinese books, would you like to read?

examples.chinese: 我要買這本書，不要買那本書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi zhè běn shū, bú yào mǎi nà běn shū.
examples.english: I want to buy this book, not that one.

examples.chinese: 我要買大蛋糕，不要買小蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi dà dàngāo, bú yào mǎi xiǎo dàngāo.
examples.english: I want to buy a big cake, not a small one.

examples.chinese: 我要買大蛋糕，不要買小蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi dà dàngāo, bú yào mǎi xiǎo dàngāo.
examples.english: I want to buy a big cake, not a small one.

examples.chinese: 你很渴嗎？我有一瓶飲料，你要不要喝？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hěn kě ma? Wǒ yǒu yì píng yǐnliào, nǐ yào bú yào hē?
examples.english: Are you thirsty? I have a bottle of beverage, would you like to have some?

examples.chinese: 我的中文書很多，你要不要看？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Zhōngwén shū hěn duō, nǐ yào bú yào kàn?
examples.english: I have many Chinese books, would you like to read?

examples.chinese: 我要買這本書，不要買那本書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi zhè běn shū, bú yào mǎi nà běn shū.
examples.english: I want to buy this book, not that one.

examples.chinese: 我要買大蛋糕，不要買小蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi dà dàngāo, bú yào mǎi xiǎo dàngāo.
examples.english: I want to buy a big cake, not a small one.

examples.chinese: 今天是星期五，明天是週末，你們要不要來我家？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqí wǔ, míngtiān shì zhōumò, nǐmen yào bú yào lái wǒ jiā?
examples.english: Today is Friday and it is the weekend tomorrow. Do you want to come to my place?

examples.chinese: A:你要不要去樓下的客廳看電視？ B:謝謝，我想先去樓上的房間休息。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào bù yào qù lóuxià de kètīng kàn diànshì? B: Xièxie, wǒ xiǎng xiān qù lóushàng de fángjiān xiūxi.
examples.english: A: Do you want to go to the living room downstairs to watch TV? B: Thanks, I want to go to the room upstairs to rest first.

examples.chinese: 我要坐電梯，不要走樓梯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào zuò diàntī, bù yào zǒu lóutī.
examples.english: I want to take the elevator, not walk the stairs.

examples.chinese: 媽媽告訴我，不要忘記去超級市場買飲料。
examples.pinyin: Māma gàosu wǒ, bùyào wàngjì qù chāojí shìchǎng mǎi yǐnliào.
examples.english: Mom told me not to forget to go to the supermarket to buy drinks.

examples.chinese: A:你什麼時候有空？要不要跟我去唱歌？ B:我今天下午有空。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shénme shíhou yǒu kòng? Yào bú yào gēn wǒ qù chànggē? B: Wǒ jīntiān xiàwǔ yǒu kòng.
examples.english: A: When are you free? Do you want to go sing with me? B: I'm free this afternoon.

examples.chinese: 他們在裡面談話，你現在不要進去。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài lǐmiàn tánhuà, nǐ xiànzài búyào jìnqù.
examples.english: They are talking inside; don't go in now.

examples.chinese: 兒子跟女兒都在睡覺，你不要說得太大聲。
examples.pinyin: Érzi gēn nǚ'ér dōu zài shuìjiào, nǐ búyào shuō de tài dàshēng.
examples.english: Both my son and daughter are sleeping; don't speak too loudly.

examples.chinese: 他不是壞人，你不要怕他。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú shì huàirén, nǐ búyào pà tā.
examples.english: He is not a bad person; don't be afraid of him.

examples.chinese: 你不要忘了告訴他明天有考試。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào wàng le gàosu tā míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì.
examples.english: Don't forget to tell him that there is an exam tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 這個週末有一場演唱會，你要不要跟我一起去看？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò yǒu yī chǎng yǎnchànghuì, nǐ yào bu yào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù kàn?
examples.english: This weekend there is a concert, do you want to go watch it with me?

examples.chinese: 我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察。A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, lǐmiàn yǒu hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, děi mǎshàng gàosu jǐngchá. A: Nǐ zěnme yīzhí késòu? Yào bùyào qù kàn yīshēng? B: Bù yàojǐn, wǒ chī guò yào le, xiūxi yīxià jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: I lost my wallet; inside were my passport and credit card. This matter is very important; I must tell the police immediately. A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's not important; I've taken medicine, and I'll be fine after a little rest.

examples.chinese: 如果這個週末你沒有什麼打算，要不要跟我去看看臺灣規模最大的書店？
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhège zhōumò nǐ méiyǒu shénme dǎsuàn, yào bù yào gēn wǒ qù kànkan Táiwān guīmó zuì dà de shūdiàn?
examples.english: If you don't have any plans this weekend, do you want to go with me to see Taiwan's largest bookstore?

examples.chinese: 那家店正在推銷巧克力口味的小籠包，我們要不要去嘗試一下？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zhèngzài tuīxiāo qiǎokèlì kǒuwèi de xiǎolóngbāo, wǒmen yào bù yào qù chángshì yīxià?
examples.english: That shop is promoting chocolate-flavored soup dumplings; shall we go try them?

examples.chinese: 黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng. Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise. This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 明天的主管會議在三樓的會議室舉行，經理要求大家不要遲到。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de zhǔguǎn huìyì zài sān lóu de huìyìshì jǔxíng, jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā búyào chídào.
examples.english: Tomorrow's supervisor meeting will be held in the meeting room on the third floor; the manager requires everyone not to be late.

examples.chinese: 我很擔心他，請他去看醫生，也告訴他要聽醫生的話，不要忘記多喝水、多休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn dānxīn tā, qǐng tā qù kàn yīshēng, yě gàosu tā yào tīng yīshēng de huà, bú yào wàngjì duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí.
examples.english: I’m so worried about him, so I told him to go see a doctor. I also told him to listen to the doctor, to drink plenty of water and get some rest.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

items.wordHook: 不(no) + 要(want) → 'no want' → don't (as a command).

examples.chinese: 我很累，想回宿舍休息！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn lèi, xiǎng huí sùshè xiūxi!
examples.english: I am very tired; I want to go back to the dorm to rest!

examples.chinese: 好。我先回宿舍做功課，再跟你一起去找他。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo. Wǒ xiān huí sùshè zuò gōngkè, zài gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: Okay. I will go back to the dormitory to do my homework first, then I will go to see him with you.

examples.chinese: A:你現在要回宿舍嗎？ B:還沒，我要先去吃飯再回宿舍。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yào huí sùshè ma? B: Hái méi, wǒ yào xiān qù chīfàn zài huí sùshè.
examples.english: A: Are you going back to the dorm now? B: Not yet; I want to go eat first and then go back to the dorm.

examples.chinese: 住在學校宿舍有一些限制，比如說晚上十點前必須回到宿舍。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài xuéxiào sùshè yǒu yīxiē xiànzhì, bǐrú shuō wǎnshang shí diǎn qián bìxū huídào sùshè.
examples.english: Living in the school dormitory has some restrictions, for example, you must return to the dormitory before ten o'clock at night.

examples.chinese: 因為學校缺乏經費，宿舍的電腦設備暫時沒辦法改善。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi xuéxiào quēfá jīngfèi, sùshè de diànnǎo shèbèi zànshí méi bànfǎ gǎishàn.
examples.english: Because the school lacks funds, the computer equipment in the dormitory cannot be improved for the time being.

items.wordHook: 宿(lodge) + 舍(house) → a house for lodging, a dorm.

examples.chinese: 爺爺去過阿里山好幾回，每次去都看到不同的風景，他說非常值得。
examples.pinyin: Yéye qù guò Ālǐshān hǎo jǐ huí, měi cì qù dōu kàn dào bùtóng de fēngjǐng, tā shuō fēicháng zhídé.
examples.english: Grandpa has been to Alishan several times; every time he goes, he sees different scenery, and he says it's very worthwhile.

examples.chinese: 阿里山擁有豐富的森林資源和獨特的自然風景，每年都吸引不少遊客去那裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān yǒngyǒu fēngfù de sēnlín zīyuán hé dútè de zìrán fēngjǐng, měi nián dōu xīyǐn bùshǎo yóukè qù nàlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: Alishan owns rich forest resources and unique natural scenery, attracting many tourists to travel there every year.

examples.chinese: 阿里山上的樹木又高又粗，好幾棵樹木的年齡都超過一千年了。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān shàng de shùmù yòu gāo yòu cū, hǎojǐ kē shùmù de niánlíng dōu chāoguò yīqiān nián le.
examples.english: The trees on Alishan are both tall and thick; several of them are over a thousand years old.

examples.chinese: 除夕那一天，要拜完祖先才能吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Chúxī nà yī tiān, yào bài wán zǔxiān cái néng chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, you must finish worshipping the ancestors before you can eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 今年的年夜飯有很多菜，雞鴨魚肉什麼都有。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de niányèfàn yǒu hěn duō cài, jī yā yú ròu shénme dōu yǒu.
examples.english: This year's New Year's Eve dinner has many dishes: chicken, duck, fish, meat—everything.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺的想法很傳統，除夕一定要大家回去吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye de xiǎngfǎ hěn chuántǒng, Chúxī yídìng yào dàjiā huíqù chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: My grandfather's thinking is very traditional; on New Year's Eve, he insists that everyone go back to eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 過年回家吃年夜飯，大家吃著吃著，就喝起酒來了，每喝幾杯，就唱一首歌，熱鬧極了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián huí jiā chī niányèfàn, dàjiā chī zhe chī zhe, jiù hē qǐ jiǔ lái le, měi hē jǐ bēi, jiù chàng yì shǒu gē, rènao jí le.
examples.english: When we go home for Chinese New Year to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, as everyone eats and eats, they start drinking; every few cups, they sing a song—it's extremely lively.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都會跟親人聚在一起吃年夜飯、給紅包，互相恭喜新年好。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài chúxī nà tiān, dōu huì gēn qīnrén jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn, gěi hóngbāo, hùxiāng gōngxǐ xīnnián hǎo.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people always gather with their kinsfolk to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, give red envelopes, and wish each other a Happy New Year.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都要回到父母身邊，全家聚在一起吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài Chúxī nà tiān, dōu yào huídào fùmǔ shēnbiān, quánjiā jù zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people all return to their parents' side, and the whole family gathers together to eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己獨特的習俗，像華人除夕貼春聯、年夜飯的魚不能吃光就很特別。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ dútè de xísú, xiàng Huárén chúxī tiē chūnlián, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī guāng jiù hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own unique customs. For example, it is very special that Chinese people put up spring couplets on New Year's Eve and that the fish for the New Year's Eve dinner cannot be completely eaten.

examples.chinese: 追求學問就是要多用腦，不斷地學，不斷地問。
examples.pinyin: Zhuīqiú xuéwèn jiùshì yào duō yòng nǎo, bùduàn de xué, bùduàn de wèn.
examples.english: Pursuing learning means using your brain more, constantly learning, and constantly asking questions.

examples.chinese: 這幾個數學問題我都不懂，不知道怎麼算。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge shùxué wèntí wǒ dōu bù dǒng, bù zhīdào zěnme suàn.
examples.english: I don't understand any of these math problems; I don't know how to calculate them.

examples.chinese: 大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě. Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.
examples.english: Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand. The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him.

examples.chinese: 這個地區的地形有三分之一是平原，三分之二是高山。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de dìxíng yǒu sān fēn zhī yī shì píngyuán, sān fēn zhī èr shì gāoshān.
examples.english: One third of the landscape in this area is plains, and two thirds are high mountains.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風可能帶來大量雨水，地形較低的地區應該多注意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng kěnéng dàilái dàliàng yǔshuǐ, dìxíng jiào dī de dìqū yīnggāi duō zhùyì.
examples.english: This typhoon may bring a great amount of rain, so areas with lower terrain should pay more attention.

examples.chinese: 在這個地區，山地是最主要的地形，因此人口較少。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège dìqū, shāndì shì zuì zhǔyào de dìxíng, yīncǐ rénkǒu jiào shǎo.
examples.english: In this region, mountainous terrain is the most dominant landform; therefore, the population is relatively small.

items.wordHook: Combining 地(earth) and 形(form): 地形 means landscape.

examples.chinese: 這部戲的男主角英俊、女主角漂亮，加上演員都演得很好，所以非常受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xì de nán zhǔjué yīngjùn, nǚ zhǔjué piàoliang, jiāshàng yǎnyuán dōu yǎn de hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ fēicháng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: The male lead in this drama is handsome and the female lead is pretty; moreover, all the actors act very well, so it is extremely popular.

examples.chinese: 人的一生就如一場電影，故事中的每個人都是主角。
examples.pinyin: Rén de yīshēng jiù rú yī chǎng diànyǐng, gùshì zhōng de měi gè rén dōu shì zhǔjiǎo.
examples.english: A person's life is like a movie; everyone in the story is the main character.

examples.chinese: 喜劇中的男女主角，不論相處過程中碰到多少挫折，結局總是快樂又幸福的。
examples.pinyin: Xǐjù zhōng de nánnǚ zhǔjiǎo, búlùn xiāngchǔ guòchéng zhōng pèngdào duōshǎo cuòzhé, jiéjú zǒngshì kuàilè yòu xìngfú de.
examples.english: In comedies, no matter how many setbacks the male and female leads encounter during their time together, the ending is always happy and blissful.

examples.chinese: 故事中的女主角吻了白馬一下，白馬就變成了英俊的國王。
examples.pinyin: Gùshì zhōng de nǚzhǔjiǎo wěn le báimǎ yīxià, báimǎ jiù biànchéng le yīngjùn de guówáng.
examples.english: The female protagonist in the story kissed the white horse once, and the white horse turned into a handsome king.

examples.chinese: 想導演一部以蟲子當作主角的電影，真不是件容易的事。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng dǎoyǎn yī bù yǐ chóngzi dàngzuò zhǔjiǎo de diànyǐng, zhēn bù shì jiàn róngyì de shì.
examples.english: Wanting to direct a movie with insects as the main characters is really not an easy thing.

items.wordHook: Combining 主(master) and 角(angle): 主角 means leading role character, role.

examples.chinese: 外面下著大雨，路很滑，請小心開車。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn xià zhe dàyǔ, lù hěn huá, qǐng xiǎoxīn kāichē.
examples.english: It's raining heavily outside, the road is very slippery, please drive carefully.

examples.chinese: 張先生滑雪的技巧很好，這次比賽他有信心能夠得到前三名。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng huáxuě de jìqiǎo hěn hǎo, zhè cì bǐsài tā yǒu xìnxīn nénggòu dédào qián sān míng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's skiing skills are very good; for this competition, he has confidence that he can get into the top three.

examples.chinese: 像衝浪、滑雪那樣的戶外活動，又刺激又好玩，不用說，絕對能吸引青少年。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng chōnglàng, huáxuě nàyàng de hùwài huódòng, yòu cìjī yòu hǎowán, bùyòng shuō, juéduì néng xīyǐn qīngshàonián.
examples.english: Outdoor activities like surfing and skiing are both exciting and fun; needless to say, they can definitely attract teenagers.

examples.chinese: 滑雪是很刺激的活動，需要很好的技巧。李小姐受不了離婚的刺激，已經好幾天吃不好、睡不好了。
examples.pinyin: Huáxuě shì hěn cìjī de huódòng, xūyào hěn hǎo de jìqiǎo. Lǐ xiǎojiě shòu bù liǎo líhūn de cìjī, yǐjīng hǎo jǐ tiān chī bù hǎo, shuì bù hǎo le.
examples.english: Skiing is a very exciting activity that requires good skills. Miss Li couldn't handle the shock of divorce, and has been unable to eat or sleep well for several days.

examples.chinese: 每年冬天快到時，舅舅和舅媽就開始計畫去滑雪，有時還約我跟媽媽一起去。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dōngtiān kuài dào shí, jiùjiu hé jiùmā jiù kāishǐ jìhuà qù huáxuě, yǒushí hái yuē wǒ gēn māma yīqǐ qù.
examples.english: Every year when winter is approaching, my uncle and aunt start planning to go skiing, and sometimes they even invite me and my mom to go together.

examples.chinese: 下過雨後道路比較滑，開車時速度別太快。
examples.pinyin: Xià guò yǔ hòu dàolù bǐjiào huá, kāichē shí sùdù bié tài kuài.
examples.english: After it has rained, the road is rather slippery; when driving, don't go too fast.

examples.chinese: 他第一次嘗試滑雪，跌了好幾次，好不容易才學會。
examples.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì chángshì huáxuě, diē le hǎo jǐ cì, hǎobùróngyì cái xuéhuì.
examples.english: He tried skiing for the first time, fell several times, and only managed to learn it with great difficulty.

examples.chinese: 我們特地到當地的滑雪用品工廠參觀，並進行技術交流。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen tèdì dào dāngdì de huáxuě yòngpǐn gōngchǎng cānguān, bìng jìnxíng jìshù jiāoliú.
examples.english: We specially visited a local ski equipment factory and conducted technical exchanges.

items.wordHook: A splash of slick 氵(water) spilled across a smooth polished 骨(bone) causes feet to suddenly 滑(slip).

examples.chinese: 有幾位學生的期中考沒考好，教授要他們下星期補考。出門上班前，我才發現短裙破了，不得不先補號再去上班，結果就遲到了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu jǐ wèi xuéshēng de qīzhōngkǎo méi kǎo hǎo, jiàoshòu yào tāmen xià xīngqī bǔkǎo. Chūmén shàngbān qián, wǒ cái fāxiàn duǎnqún pò le, bùdébù xiān bǔ hǎo zài qù shàngbān, jiéguǒ jiù chídào le.
examples.english: Several students didn't do well on the midterm exam, so the professor wants them to take a make-up exam next week. Before going out to work, I discovered that my skirt was torn, and I had no choice but to mend it first before going to work, and as a result, I was late.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 許多青少年為了考上好學校，不得不犧牲假日去補習。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō qīngshàonián wèile kǎo shàng hǎo xuéxiào, bùdébù xīshēng jiàrì qù bǔxí.
examples.english: Many teenagers, in order to get into a good school, have no choice but to sacrifice their holidays to go to cram school.

examples.chinese: 大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。
examples.pinyin: Dàbǎo míngnián yǒu qù Yīngguó liúxué de dǎsuàn, suǒyǐ zhǎo le jiātíng jiàoshī bāng tā bǔxí, xīwàng tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù.
examples.english: Dabao plans to study abroad in the UK next year, so he found a private tutor to help him with cram tutoring, hoping to improve his English level.

examples.chinese: 經理因商品售完而跟顧客道歉，並表示明天就會補上。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yīn shāngpǐn shòu wán ér gēn gùkè dàoqiàn, bìng biǎoshì míngtiān jiù huì bǔ shàng.
examples.english: The manager apologized to the customer because the product was sold out, and indicated that it would be restocked tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我的裙子破了個洞，還好室友有針和線，幫我補了起來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qúnzi pòle ge dòng, háohǎo shìyǒu yǒu zhēn hé xiàn, bāng wǒ bǔle qǐlái.
examples.english: My skirt had a hole, but luckily my roommate had a needle and thread and helped me mend it.

examples.chinese: 運動後吃根香蕉可以補充體力。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng hòu chī gēn xiāngjiāo kěyǐ bǔchōng tǐlì.
examples.english: Eating a banana after exercise can replenish your energy.

examples.chinese: 運動選手在參加比賽前，補充營養的飲食很重要。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng xuǎnshǒu zài cānjiā bǐsài qián, bǔchōng yíngyǎng de yǐnshí hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: Before athletes participate in a competition, a diet that replenishes nutrition is very important.

items.wordHook: A 衤(cloth) that 甫(to begin) to tear needs a needle and thread to make it whole again: 補(fix).

examples.chinese: 過年時，著名點心店都會收到大量的訂單，甚至有顧客在半年前就下訂單了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián shí, zhùmíng diǎnxīn diàn dōu huì shōudào dàliàng de dìngdān, shènzhì yǒu gùkè zài bàn nián qián jiù xià dìngdān le.
examples.english: During Chinese New Year, famous pastry shops receive a large number of orders; some customers even place orders half a year in advance.

examples.chinese: 學校的游泳比賽報名時間到今天截止，有興趣的同學別錯過了。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de yóuyǒng bǐsài bàomíng shíjiān dào jīntiān jiézhǐ, yǒu xìngqù de tóngxué bié cuòguò le.
examples.english: Registration for the school's swimming competition closes today; classmates who are interested should not miss it.

items.key: ["B4L06-2-33","台上一分钟，台下十年功","臺上一分鐘，臺下十年功","台上一分钟，台下十年功","Ph"]

items.wordHook: Passing files 上(on top) onto networks to 傳(pass) data across the cloud: 上傳 means upload.
A weary 亻(person) leans their weight against an honorable elder 丈(gentleman) for trusted support: 仗(1to rely upon).
晚(evening) + 會(gathering) → an evening gathering for entertainment.
Combining 滿(full) and 月(moon): 滿月 means a baby's completion of its first month of life.
a 犭(dog) calls out a 句(sentence) aloud → a friendly 狗(dog).
Advancing 進(enter) forward by 一(one) single 步(walk): 進一步 means further.
